theorems.name: Maithic.Algo.insertSorted_perm
theorems.statement:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α] [inst_1 : DecidableLE α] (x : α) (l : List α),
  (Maithic.Algo.insertSorted x l).Perm (x :: l)

theorems.name: Maithic.Algo.insertionSort_idem
theorems.statement:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α] [inst_1 : DecidableLE α] [Maithic.Algo.TotalPreorder α] (l : List α),
  Maithic.Algo.insertionSort (Maithic.Algo.insertionSort l) = Maithic.Algo.insertionSort l

theorems.name: Maithic.Algo.insertionSort_of_sorted
theorems.statement:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α] [inst_1 : DecidableLE α] {l : List α},
  Maithic.Algo.Sorted l → Maithic.Algo.insertionSort l = l

theorems.name: Maithic.Algo.insertionSort_perm
theorems.statement:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α] [inst_1 : DecidableLE α] (l : List α),
  (Maithic.Algo.insertionSort l).Perm l

theorems.name: Maithic.Algo.length_insertionSort
theorems.statement:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α] [inst_1 : DecidableLE α] (l : List α),
  (Maithic.Algo.insertionSort l).length = l.length

theorems.name: Maithic.Algo.mem_insertSorted
theorems.statement:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α] [inst_1 : DecidableLE α] {x z : α} {l : List α},
  z ∈ Maithic.Algo.insertSorted x l ↔ z = x ∨ z ∈ l

theorems.name: Maithic.Algo.mem_insertionSort
theorems.statement:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α] [inst_1 : DecidableLE α] {x : α} {l : List α},
  x ∈ Maithic.Algo.insertionSort l ↔ x ∈ l

theorems.name: Maithic.Algo.sorted_insertSorted
theorems.statement:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α] [inst_1 : DecidableLE α] [Maithic.Algo.TotalPreorder α] (x : α)
  {l : List α}, Maithic.Algo.Sorted l → Maithic.Algo.Sorted (Maithic.Algo.insertSorted x l)

theorems.name: Maithic.Algo.sorted_insertionSort
theorems.statement:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : LE α] [inst_1 : DecidableLE α] [Maithic.Algo.TotalPreorder α] (l : List α),
  Maithic.Algo.Sorted (Maithic.Algo.insertionSort l)
